facts.fact: The IPDCP, Togo's personal data protection authority, held a ceremony at its seat on 18 November 2026 presided by its President, Colonel Belei Bediani, to hand certificates to 28 data protection correspondents.
facts.system: Instance de Protection des Donnees a Caractere Personnel (IPDCP)

TGO.note: No ruling or count of rulings stated.

facts.fact: The IPDCP, with a President in office, was acting on 18 November 2026 as the data protection authority, according to its own release.
The IPDCP says it trained data protection correspondents from June 2026, assessed them on 30 September and 1 October, and certified the first 28 on 18 November 2026, for three-year certificates.

TGO.note: Names no law, its standing or regulations.

facts.fact: The IPDCP, led by its President Colonel Belei Bediani, was at work on 18 November 2026, according to its own release.

The IPDCP trained correspondents on the legal framework from June 2026, assessed them on 30 September and 1 October, and certified the first 28 on 18 November 2026, drawn from banks, insurers, telecom operators, port bodies, local authorities and digital firms.

TGO.note: No law named; no ruling stated.
No ICT employment figure or graduate unemployment stated.
Only local authorities' staff among certified correspondents; no connection stated.
